Hi all — I reviewed HexaTek's redlines and their PO requirements. High-level notes below; detailed redline attached.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Redlines_v2.pdf (PDF) — inline comments and proposed language.

Summary:
- Payment terms: We can accept Net 45 for enterprise customers on a case-by-case basis. For this deal (Deal ID DEAL-HTX-2025-09), approve Net 45 for 12 months, then revert to Net 30 unless HexaTek provides a credit facility. Please capture this as a 12-month negotiated term in the Order Form.
- Data/security: HexaTek requested a clause limiting logging/retention. Our standard approach is acceptable with a short exception; propose the language in the attached doc.
- Liability cap: HexaTek asks to increase to 6x fees — we propose 3x fees and explain exposure; ok to negotiate but request their legal rationale.

Next steps:
1) Sergio/Marissa — confirm commercial point (Net 45 for 12 months) so I can finalize the redline.
2) Once agreed, I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope for: (a) MSA (redlined), (b) Order Form with payment term clause and first-year pricing.

If HexaTek can provide Coupa vendor contact, their team can issue the invite while we finalize signatures.

Lauren Bishop
